notes: Collection, Pack Opening, and Deck Builder now show each card's unique illustrated art.
fixes: Collection, Pack Opening, and Deck Builder now display each card's unique illustrated art instead of placeholder images. All screens share a single art loader so battle, menus, and pack reveals always show the same illustration for every card.
features: All 123 cards now have unique AI-generated art matched to each card's name, class, and rarity. Hope cards glow with warm purple and gold dawn light; Courage burns with crimson and amber; Serenity flows in soft teal and blue; Purpose is grounded in warm gold and earth tones; Neutral shows community and fellowship scenes.

Shiny holographic card variants are now in the game. Every card drawn from a pack has a 0.5% independent chance to be a shiny — they render with a slow rainbow foil color cycle and sparkle particle bursts, get their own spotlight reveal sequence, and are tracked separately from your regular collection copies. Shinies can only be drawn, never crafted.
The Pull Odds screen now discloses the 0.5% shiny chance per card drawn, keeping the loot-box disclosure accurate.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
